consequence.statement: Pods and external listener Services no longer carry the `statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name` label, so custom setups that use this label no longer find it.
consequence.remediation: Change any custom setup that uses `statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name` to use the `strimzi.io/pod-name` label instead.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removed the `statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name` label from pods and external listener Services; custom setups that use it should use `strimzi.io/pod-name` instead.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the subject is a Kubernetes label on operator-managed pods and Services, and no subject family covers a resource label; applicability: the evidence only says 'any custom setup leveraging such label' and does not name which resources or fields (selectors, policies, monitoring) would reference it, so no predicate can be pinned
